title: gentianella cunninghamii subsp. major
intro: Gentianella cunninghamii subsp. major, commonly known as a type of flowering plant in the Gentianaceae family, is native to New Zealand. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as reducing inflammation and fighting against infections. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antiviral agent, making it useful in treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents of Gentianella cunninghamii subsp. major include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
